content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Master’s degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with 4/5 years bachelor’s degree. Those with 3 years bachelor’s degree must have UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET qualification or equivalent or a Ph.D.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age relaxation: five years for SC/ST & women and three years for OBC. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: ₹37,000 + HRA/month for 1st and 2nd year; ₹42,000 + HRA/month for 3rd year

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) positions at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute is scheduled for 10 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position under the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with a 4/5 years bachelor’s degree. Those with a 3-year bachelor's degree need UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the SRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the ICAR IARI SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi - 110012.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: five years for SC/ST and women candidates, and three years for OBC candidates.
